questions.question: Calculate 2 3/4 + 1 2/3, showing the common denominator you used.
Calculate 2 2/3 − 1 3/4 and explain the borrowing step.
Why is 3/4 + 2/3 not equal to 5/7?
questions.expected_answer: Denominators name the piece size and are not added. 5/7 is less than 1, but 3/4 + 2/3 is clearly more than 1; the correct sum is 17/12 = 1 5/12.
